hard_rules: No active recommendation rule without at least one evidence_claim_id.
No active evidence claim without at least one identifiable source.
No personalized dose without an explicit evidence-backed dose rule.
Safety blocks are evaluated before positive recommendation scoring.
Missing required data yields insufficient_user_data, not inferred answers.
Goals and marketing entry points prioritize exploration only; they do not independently justify supplementation.
Family history prioritizes assessment but does not prove benefit from preventive supplementation.
Symptoms alone do not diagnose nutrient deficiency.
The same structured scientific record should feed both the rule engine and the public Vitami Library where appropriate.
Every active item carries review/version metadata.
phase2_gate: Only after Phase 1 v1.0 is frozen should real supplement evidence and rules be populated.
